deployedStartupFallback.note: A first script probe ran before documentElement existed; the null-guarded rerun succeeded. Instrumentation TypeError from the discarded first probe is not an application error.

homeHtml.evidence: Chrome DevTools response headers on v30

consoleAndRuntime.explanation: ChatGPT Sites injects a per-response inline Cloudflare bootstrap whose hash is not in the static application CSP; the browser blocks it. No unsafe-inline relaxation was made. The app remains interactive and no extra external request was observed.

targetedIssueChecks.evidence: The accessible Workbench fallback appeared in the deployed mobile cold-start probe before the editor finished initializing.
Toggle stayed within the same frame URL, then Replay Entrance announced that animation was skipped; see quality/evidence/step-38/deployed-v30-fade-up-reveal-motion.json.
Six visible isolated Explore previews rendered; lazy cards are labelled; 108 requests had no failures.
v30 homepage HTML response returned Content-Encoding: gzip while retaining the public cache policy.
Sites-injected inline bootstrap remains blocked by strict CSP; no safe repository-only change identified.
4x CPU Fast 4G Workbench LCP measured 2559-2809ms; at 1x CPU it measured 1296ms; field CrUX is unavailable.

followUpAndLimits: The Workbench 4x CPU mobile traces slightly exceed the 2.5s field p75 threshold, but lab data cannot establish field failure; no source-level hotspot or credible savings estimate was found.
AUD-342 is an external Sites runtime constraint and remains a real console error; strict CSP was not weakened.
No new Axe suite was run as part of this performance follow-up; prior version Axe results are historical and are not attributed to v30 here.
This evidence completes the Step 38 route/workload and deployed-trace scope only; the broader product-hardening programme remains in progress.
